kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Chuck Schumer heralds Democrats' 'generational remake' of Senate
wire.summary: In remarks the day after his party flipped control of Congress, the Senate Minority Leader said voters had spoken clearly about their priorities, and said it's up to the Democratic party to deliver.

wire.title: Mike Johnson will step aside as top House Republican next Congress
wire.summary: After Tuesday's bruising defeat for Republicans, House Speaker Mike Johnson will not stay on as minority leader come January.

wire.title: Back in the majority, Democrats have plans for a long list of Trump investigations
wire.summary: Democrats will have the ability to subpoena records and compel individuals to testify. The Epstein files, Elon Musk, the Iran war and Trump's business interests may all come under the microscope.

wire.title: Kansas just elected a Democrat. His message to Washington? Be decent
wire.summary: The Methodist pastor who flipped a Republican Senate seat says voters want more than political change. He tells NPR what he heard from Kansans about decency, faith and finding common ground.

wire.title: Abdul El-Sayed welcomes Trump's plan to cut Israel aid, calls for end to arms sales
wire.summary: Michigan's first Muslim senator-elect, Abdul El-Sayed, discusses his historic victory, an unlikely agreement with Trump on Israel military aid and the political divisions that remain.

wire.title: The world is reacting to the Democrats' sweeping midterm elections victory
wire.summary: From Kyiv to Moscow, and Tehran to Tel Aviv, all eyes were on the Democrats big win as foreign powers weigh how a flipped Congress will affect international relations.

wire.title: Democrats seize full control of Congress. And, which candidates made history last night

wire.title: 6 takeaways from Democrats' big wave on election night

wire.title: Votes are still being counted to see who will represent Mississippi in the Senate
wire.summary: Votes are still being counted to determine who will represent Mississippi in the U.S. Senate. Democrat Scott Colom was only a handful of votes ahead of Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith early Wednesday.

wire.title: Stacey Abrams says Democrat wins in Georgia offer opportunity for 'correcting and restoring rights'
wire.summary: After a historic election night for Georgia and many southern states, former Georgia gubernatorial candidate Stacey Abrams speaks to Morning Edition about what these wins mean for Democrats.

wire.title: 'This is a disaster': Angry Republicans blame Trump for midterms defeat
wire.summary: Some Republicans tell the BBC the president's focus on his legacy and indifference to voter concerns cost them.

wire.title: US midterm results a 'victory' for Canadians hopeful of tariff relief
wire.summary: With Canada-US trade talks back on, Tuesday’s midterm Democratic wave puts pressure on the White House to come to a deal.

wire.title: Ukraine says bodycam video shows deadly Russian double-tap bombing
wire.summary: At least 40 people were killed and another 30 may still be under the rubble after Monday's attack on a Ukrainian village, Kyiv says.

wire.title: French blood storage impacted by freezer hacks as theories swirl about culprits
wire.summary: The French Blood Establishment (EFS) said cold rooms storing blood were impacted by hackers.

wire.title: 'Most difficult days of my life' for keeper Owono
wire.summary: FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono puts out a statement through his club, expressing his sorrow and pain after Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel's death.

wire.title: Israel's president begins consultations with parties after election deadlock
wire.summary: Herzog warns politicians that "not every commitment and promise can be fulfilled" if they want to avoid another election.
